name: Autumn Dawn
source:
A freelance journalist accredited with COSA, Autumn Dawn has built her career on visibility, privileged access, and sensationalism. Her power allows her to record and retransmit with perfect fidelity everything she sees, making her a valuable asset for reports, official broadcasts, and controlled information campaigns. More a media presence than a true investigator, she has become one of the most recognizable faces in scionic journalism.

[In game description]
